primary_endpoint: main E20 between-minus-within canonical Alpha balanced, direct canonical profile Hungarian assignment
uncertainty: dataset-stratified delete-one-complete-run jackknife; paired-seed-block jackknife for task cohort
early_onset: first post-initialization sampled update with entire pointwise 95% contrast interval > 0; no multiplicity adjustment, as in paper
functional_progress: mean over datasets of (accuracy(s)-accuracy(0))/(accuracy(470)-accuracy(0)); first checkpoint >= 0.9
validation: independent direct metric and CKA calculations
comparison_policy: Published values are references only and are never substituted for recomputed measurements. Numerical differences and unidentifiable protocol choices are reported. Exact replay requires original code/checkpoints.
